newsitem.title: CHINA: China PC sales seen at 1.7 million in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China PC sales seen at 1.7 million in 1996.

text.p: Total sales of personal computers in China are expected to reach 1.7 million in 1996, of which 20 percent or about 350,000 units will be home computers, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
Last year, the number of home computers rose by more than 200 percent compared with 1994. This year, the growth rate had dropped to about 60 percent compared with 1995, it said.
In 1995, personal computer sales in China totalled 1.1 million units, 50 percent more than in 1994.
China has forecast that annual sales of personal computers will reach five million by 2000.
